title: Jiangsu Jiayun New Materials Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Jiangsu Jiayun New Materials Co., Ltd. is a Chinese aerogel manufacturer focused on silica aerogel materials and aerogel composite products. The company publicly describes itself as a specialist in aerogel R&D, production preparation, and technical service, with applications across industry, batteries, buildings, and aerospace.

Company Overview

Jiayun states that it works with major research platforms including Nanjing Tech University and key laboratory resources to move aerogel science from research into scaled manufacturing. Its portfolio covers silica aerogel powders, blankets, microspheres, slurries, coatings, and battery thermal barriers.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Mainland China with international-facing business development.
  • Focus Areas: Industrial insulation, new-energy batteries, energy storage, building materials, and specialty aerogel composites.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel powder, particles, and microspheres
  • Aerogel insulation blankets
  • Aerogel slurries and coatings
  • Battery aerogel thermal pads
  • Public Capacity: Not clearly disclosed on the reviewed public pages.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Site: Jiangsu / Nanjing-linked operations, China.
  • International Certifications: Public pages reference ISO certification and patents, but detailed certificate information is not clearly listed on the pages reviewed.
  • Official Website: http://jyaerogel.com/
